summary: Master Trade Compliance, Customs, and Incoterms 2020 in 5 days. Learn HS classification, customs valuation, and strategic Incoterm application. Enroll now for e
lede: Trade compliance and customs training helps import and export professionals apply trade rules to shipments and documentation. Participants practise classifying goods with Harmonized System rules, calculating customs value, and selecting Incoterms 2020 while aligning shipping documents with agreed responsibilities. The syllabus also covers customs entry procedures, restricted-party screening, and internal controls for trade compliance programs.

Country of Origin and Trade Agreements

prerequisites: Participants should have basic familiarity with international trade concepts (e.g., import/export basics) and working knowledge of Excel. No coding or advanced software skills are required. Bring a laptop for hands-on documentation exercises.
